title: Developers | Verse Engine by Ctruh
description: Upload, publish, embed and track 3D scenes with a REST API — or skip the backend and drop in one script tag.
html:
FOR DEVELOPERS · REST API + EMBED SDK

Build Verse Engine
into your product.

Upload, publish, embed and track 3D scenes with a REST API — or skip the backend and drop in one script tag.

Get an API keyAPI reference 
<!-- Embed a scene -->
<script src="https://verse.ctruh.com/embed.js"
        data-scene="your-scene"></script>

Replace your-scene with the published scene ID.

THE ROUND TRIP

  1. 01POST /v1/ingest

    Send a file, a scan or a floor plan.

  2. 02processing

    Verse Engine prepares and signs it once.

  3. 03ready → share link

    Your server hears the moment it’s live.

  4. 04<verse-viewer>

    Drop the ID into any page. Done.

API

API management & docs

A REST API for everything you can do in Studio.

  • Upload files and scans
  • Publish and get a signed link
  • Embed anywhere
  • Track views, sessions and watch time
  • Webhooks when a scene is ready
API docs→

SDK

SDK install & docs

Embed a scene on any site with one script tag or a web component.

  • One script tag
  • Web component for React and Vue
  • Private, revocable links
  • Works on phones, laptops and headsets
  • Run your own server
SDK install guide→

START BUILDING

Quickstart,
in three calls.

  1. 01

    Create an API key

    Sign in to Studio and create a key under Plug-ins & API.

    Open Studio
  2. 02

    Upload your first scene

    POST a file, then wait for the job to finish.

    Set up webhooks
  3. 03

    Embed it

    Add the SDK script and drop in the scene ID.

    SDK guide
